title: OpenClaw / ClawHub Malicious Skills & Control-UI RCE (CVE-2026-25253)

steps.title: Marketplace poisoning / typosquatting
steps.text: Malicious skills are published to ClawHub using typosquatted names and poisoned SKILL.md prerequisites.
steps.description: Malicious skills are published to ClawHub using typosquatted names and poisoned SKILL.md prerequisites.

steps.title: User installs malicious skill
steps.text: A user installs a malicious skill whose SKILL.md prerequisites trigger execution.
steps.description: A user installs a malicious skill whose SKILL.md prerequisites trigger execution.

steps.title: Encoded shell and archive staging
steps.text: The skill runs Base64-encoded shell commands and fetches password-protected archives.
steps.description: The skill runs Base64-encoded shell commands and fetches password-protected archives.

steps.title: AMOS stealer deployment
steps.text: AMOS (Atomic macOS Stealer) is deployed to harvest browser, Keychain and crypto credentials.
steps.description: AMOS (Atomic macOS Stealer) is deployed to harvest browser, Keychain and crypto credentials.

steps.title: Control UI WebSocket hijack (CVE-2026-25253)
steps.text: Alternatively, a malicious link abuses the Control UI gatewayUrl to hijack the WebSocket and execute host commands.
steps.description: Alternatively, a malicious link abuses the Control UI gatewayUrl to hijack the WebSocket and execute host commands.

steps.title: Host command execution via hijacked gateway
steps.text: The hijacked WebSocket is used to run arbitrary commands on the host.
steps.description: The hijacked WebSocket is used to run arbitrary commands on the host.

steps.title: Detect malicious skills and Control-UI abuse
steps.text: Blue team detects encoded shell execution from skills and anomalous WebSocket connections to the Control UI gatewayUrl.
steps.description: Blue team detects encoded shell execution from skills and anomalous WebSocket connections to the Control UI gatewayUrl.

steps.title: Contain and remediate
steps.text: SOC removes untrusted skills, upgrades to v2026.1.29, isolates hosts, revokes credentials and rebuilds agents.
steps.description: SOC removes untrusted skills, upgrades to v2026.1.29, isolates hosts, revokes credentials and rebuilds agents.
